name: Marlow
tagline: Furniture and homewares, made to be lived with.
description: Marlow is a direct-to-consumer home and living brand. Everything is designed in-house and made by a small group of workshops we've worked with for years: solid-wood furniture, hand-glazed ceramics, woven textiles and lighting that's meant to stay out of the landfill. Free shipping over $75, 100-day returns.
